annotations.title: Request a feel check (human perception panel)

description: Request that a small panel of real people rates how a text, ad, design or page comes across (trust, clarity, tone, offence risk) and explains why. Human-reviewed: you get a quote first, nothing happens before you accept. Price: EUR 29 for 5 people, EUR 49 for 10, EUR 89 for 20. Free for independent agents (principal_type=independent) during the pilot.

audience.description: Who the panel should represent, e.g. German-speaking adults 30–60.

callback_url.description: https URL for signed status webhooks.

material.description: The text to evaluate, or an https URL.

variants.description: Optional: a second variant (text or URL) for an A/B comparison.
